channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Helen Keller — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-08
item.description: “One can never consent to creep when one feels an impulse to soar.” — Helen Keller

item.title: Ralph Waldo Emerson — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-07
item.description: “Our strength grows out of our weaknesses.” — Ralph Waldo Emerson

item.title: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-06
item.description: “Look at the sky. We are not alone. The whole universe is friendly to us.” — A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

item.title: Tim Menchen — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-05
item.description: “To dream of the person you would like to be is to waste the person you are.” — Tim Menchen

item.title: Socrates — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-04
item.description: “The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.” — Socrates

item.title: James Joyce — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-03
item.description: “When the soul of a man is born in this country there are nets flung at it to hold it back from flight.” — James Joyce

item.title: Gautama Buddha — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-02
item.description: “We are what we think. All that we are arises with our thoughts. With our thoughts, we make the world.” — Gautama Buddha

item.title: Napoleon Bonaparte — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-01
item.description: “In war, the moral is to the physical as three is to one.” — Napoleon Bonaparte
